basic.question: What career suits my chart?
basic.answer_template: Based on your chart, {planet} in {sign} indicates {career_type}. Your 10th house lord {lord} in {house} house suggests {career_detail}.
basic.strength_check: If Sun strong -> government/admin/leadership; Mercury strong -> writing/teaching/commerce; Saturn strong -> engineering/admin/slow steady growth

basic.question: When will I get a job promotion?
basic.framework: Check current dasha period and transit to 10th house
basic.answer_template: Your current {dasha} dasha activates {planet} matters. With transit of {transit_planet} to your 10th house, this is a favorable period for promotion. Exact timing: {timing}.
basic.strength_check: Check dasha lord strength and transit aspects to 10th house

basic.question: Is business right for me?
basic.framework: Check Mercury/Venus strength and 2nd/10th house connection
basic.answer_template: Your Mercury {status} indicates {business_type} aptitude. With Venus {status}, {creative_business}. The 2nd house {condition} suggests {financial_outlook}.
basic.strength_check: Mercury strong -> commerce/writing; Venus strong -> creative business; 2nd house lord strength

basic.question: What field should I study?
basic.answer_template: Your 5th house {condition} shows natural aptitude. Mercury {status} in {sign} suggests {study_field}. Jupiter {status} indicates {higher_learning}.
basic.strength_check: Mercury for skills, Jupiter for higher education, 5th house creativity

intermediate.question: Will I become wealthy through my career?
intermediate.framework: Check 11th house, Jupiter/Venus strength, 10th house strength
intermediate.answer_template: Your 11th house {condition} shows income gains. Jupiter {status} indicates {wealth_type}. Venus {status} adds {financial_detail}. 10th house {condition} shows career-related wealth.
intermediate.strength_check: Jupiter strong -> prosperity through teaching/finance; Venus strong -> wealth through arts/business; 11th house strength

intermediate.question: Government job or private sector?
intermediate.framework: Check Sun strength, 10th house lord placement, Navamsa analysis
intermediate.answer_template: Sun {status} strongly favors government/service roles. 10th house lord {lord} in {navamsa} suggests {sector}. Navamsa analysis of 10th lord gives final indication.
intermediate.strength_check: Sun exalted -> government; Sun debilitated -> private sector; 10th house lord placement

intermediate.question: Which job will give me most satisfaction?
intermediate.framework: Check Moon placement, 5th house, and personal passion areas
intermediate.answer_template: Your Moon {status} in {sign} shows emotional job satisfaction needs. 5th house {condition} indicates creative fulfillment. Your passion areas: {passions}. Ideal work: {ideal_job}.
intermediate.strength_check: Moon for emotional satisfaction, 5th house for creativity, personal passion alignment

advanced.question: Is my current job suitable for my skills?
advanced.framework: Check 6th house (daily work), Mercury (skills), and 10th house (career)
advanced.answer_template: Your 6th house {condition} shows daily work environment. Mercury {status} indicates your skill set. 10th house {condition} shows career fit. Combined: {suitability_assessment}.
advanced.strength_check: 6th house for daily work, Mercury for skills, 10th for career suitability

advanced.question: What is my ideal work environment?
advanced.framework: Check Moon sign (emotional needs), 7th house (partnerships at work), and Saturn (discipline style)
advanced.answer_template: Your Moon {status} in {sign} shows needed work environment atmosphere. 7th house {condition} shows preferred workplace partnerships. Saturn {status} indicates discipline style: {discipline_style}. Ideal environment: {env_description}.
advanced.strength_check: Moon for emotional satisfaction, 7th for workplace partnerships, Saturn for discipline style

basic.question: When will I get married?
basic.framework: Check 7th house lord, Venus/Jupiter strength, dasha periods
basic.answer_template: Based on your chart, 7th house lord {lord} in {sign} with Venus {status} suggests {marriage_timing}. Current {dasha} dasha activates {activation}.
basic.strength_check: Venus strong -> early marriage; Jupiter aspect -> favorable timing; 7th house strength -> quick marriage

basic.question: What kind of partner suits me?
basic.framework: Check Venus placement, 7th house lord, and karaka strengths
basic.answer_template: Your Venus in {sign} shows partner {partner_type}. 7th house lord {lord} in {house} indicates {partner_qualities}. Mars {status} adds {mars_detail}.
basic.strength_check: Venus strong -> harmonious partner; 7th house strong -> supportive partner; Mars afflicted -> needs anger management

basic.question: Love marriage or arranged marriage?
basic.answer_template: Your 5th-7th connection {connection_type} shows {marriage_type}. Venus-Moon {aspect} indicates {love_style}. Rahu/Ketu connections show {non_traditional}.
basic.strength_check: Strong 5th-7th -> love marriage; Strong Venus-Moon -> arranged marriage possible; Rahu connections -> non-traditional

intermediate.question: Manglik dosha effects on marriage?
intermediate.framework: Check Mars placement in 1st/4th/7th/8th, Mangal dosha calculation
intermediate.strength_check: Mars in 1/4/7/8 -> Mangal dosha; Mars in own sign -> reduced effect; Aspects from Jupiter -> cancellation

intermediate.question: Second marriage possibilities?
intermediate.framework: Check 7th house lord strength, 8th house connections, dasha of 7th lord
intermediate.answer_template: 7th house lord {status} shows {second_marriage_probability}. 8th house connections {8th_status}. Dasha of 7th lord {dasha_status}.
intermediate.strength_check: Strong 7th lord -> second marriage possible; Weak 7th lord -> delayed; 8th house connections -> transformative marriages

advanced.question: Early marriage or late marriage?
advanced.framework: Check 7th house strength, Venus dasha timing, Jupiter aspects
advanced.answer_template: 7th house {strength} shows {timing}. Venus dasha {venus_dasha} activates {activation}. Jupiter aspects {jupiter_aspect}.
advanced.strength_check: Strong 7th -> early marriage; Debilitated 7th -> late marriage; Jupiter aspect -> marriage timing correction

advanced.question: Inter-caste/religion marriage possibilities?
advanced.framework: Check Rahu/Ketu connections, 7th house lord placement
advanced.answer_template: Rahu in 7th {rahu_status} shows {inter_caste_status}. Ketu connections {ketu_status}. 7th lord {lord_status}.
advanced.strength_check: Rahu in 7th -> inter-caste/marriage; Ketu aspects -> spiritual connection; 7th lord strength -> family acceptance

basic.question: Does he/she love me?
basic.framework: Check Venus position, 5th house connections, Moon-Moon aspect
basic.answer_template: Venus {status} in {sign} shows {love_indicator}. 5th house {condition} indicates {love_quality}. Moon-Moon aspect {aspect_type}.
basic.strength_check: Venus strong -> love present; Venus afflicted -> uncertainty; 5th house strong -> deep connection

basic.question: When will I meet my life partner?
basic.framework: Check 7th house dasha, Venus transit, Jupiter aspects
basic.answer_template: Current {dasha} dasha activates {planet} matters. Venus transit to {house} house. Jupiter aspect to 7th house. Timing: {timing}.
basic.strength_check: Venus transit to 7th -> partner meeting; Jupiter aspect to 7th -> significant relationship; dasha lord strength

basic.question: Is this true love or just attraction?
basic.framework: Check 5th house quality, Venus sign, Moon emotional connection
basic.answer_template: 5th house {quality} shows {love_type}. Venus {sign} shows {attraction_style}. Moon-Moon {aspect} shows {emotional_connection}. Rahu {rahu_status}.
basic.strength_check: 5th house quality -> true love vs attraction; Venus sign -> love style; Moon connection -> emotional bond

intermediate.question: Will my love marriage happen?
intermediate.framework: Check 5th-7th house connection, Venus strength, dasha timing
intermediate.answer_template: 5th-7th connection {connection_type} shows {marriage_possibility}. Venus {status} dasha activates {activation}. Jupiter aspect {jupiter_aspect}.
intermediate.strength_check: Strong 5th-7th connection -> love marriage; Venus strong dasha -> marriage timing; Jupiter aspect -> relationship blessing

intermediate.question: Why am I getting repeated heartbreaks?
intermediate.framework: Check Rahu in 5th/7th, Venus afflictions, karmic patterns
intermediate.answer_template: Rahu in {position} {rahu_status}. Venus {venus_status} afflictions. Karmic pattern {karmic_detail}. Lessons: {lessons}.
intermediate.strength_check: Rahu in 5th/7th -> relationship patterns; Venus afflict -> heartbreak patterns; Karmic lessons to learn

intermediate.question: What is my love language?
intermediate.framework: Check Venus placement, Moon sign, 5th house creativity
intermediate.answer_template: Venus {sign} shows {love_language}. Moon {sign} shows {emotional_needs}. 5th house {condition} shows {creativity_style}. Acts of service: {acts_service}.
intermediate.strength_check: Venus for love language, Moon for emotional needs, 5th for creativity expression

advanced.question: When will my romantic phase end?
advanced.framework: Check current dasha, transit to 5th/7th house
advanced.answer_template: Current {dasha} dasha activates {planet} matters. Transit of {transit_planet} to 5th/7th house. Phase ends when: {phase_end_condition}.
advanced.strength_check: Current dasha lord strength; transit aspects to 5th/7th; phase duration based on dasha period

advanced.question: Will I find love again after a breakup?
advanced.framework: Check 5th house recovery, Venus retrograde, dasha timing
advanced.answer_template: 5th house {recovery_status} shows {recovery_possibility}. Venus retrograde {retrograde_status}. Current dasha {dasha_status}. New love potential: {new_love}.
advanced.strength_check: 5th house recovery; Venus retrograde effects; current dasha for new relationship timing
